ev.q: The game saw continued development, alternating between paid expansions and free updates
set in J. R. R. Tolkien's Middle-earth
Many world regions, group instances and seasonal festivals
which can be assigned in various configurations to customize personal playstyle
Players improve their characters by upgrading their equipment
The crafting system allows each character to master up to four professions
significant emphasis is placed on cooking and agricultural farming
Legendary items, intended to stay with the player throughout the game
Players traverse the game world either on foot, using personal mounts
commented negatively on its weak PvP content
